brief.regime: Headline indices pulled back sharply with the Sensex down 1.17% and Nifty down 1.07%, though mid/small caps displayed relative stability as market breadth remained positive with 1,120 advances to 691 declines and VIX fell 1.75% to 16.55. Metals (+1.40%) and Energy (+0.15%) led gains, while IT (-1.88%) and Auto (-1.48%) dragged. Macro pressures persist as USDINR rose 0.80% to 92.98 and domestic bond yields increased, even as Brent crude fell 2.76% to $92.00.
